title: The Late Portrait
author: Tamsin Amberdale
blurb: Lena Eriksen, an estate lawyer reading a will that shouldn't exist, thought they had seen every way a life can end. But when the missing person's diary continues past the date she disappeared, she discovers that staying invisible was never really an option. To get through this, she must untangle alibis woven thirty years ago before the statute expires.
style: warm, character-driven storytelling with gentle humor
